guided_journeys.story_title: The Element With Too Many Weights
guided_journeys.tagline: Keep element identity fixed while neutron counts and isotope abundance change.

guide.name: Dr. Mina Cho
guide.visual: white lab coat, black clipboard, and a brass proton counter
guide.story_job: Mina keeps proton count, neutron count, isotope mass, and abundance physically separated.

guided_journeys.premise: A shipment of atoms has arrived with one element label but several measured masses.
guided_journeys.mission: Sort atoms by proton and neutron count, then reconstruct the weighted average that appears on the periodic table.
guided_journeys.finale: The records hall accepts several isotopes under one element identity and prints one weighted average atomic mass.
